Caption / description / post text:
Don’t touch that thermostat cause it’s finally #soupseason weather. Make this Creamy Chicken Tortilla Soup to knock the chill off the house.  It’s an easy recipe that will have the family coming back for seconds and thirds. A perfect Fall Recipe. #easyrecipes #chickentortillasoup #dinnerideas #cooking 

Transcript of the video's audio (machine-made):
Hey dad, what's for dinner? I know y'all felt that temperature change, but it ain't time to turn that heat on yet. This creamy chipotle chicken tortilla soup would knock that chill off in no time. Packed with flavor and like a hug in a bowl, let me show you how I did it. Coke boneless chicken thighs and oil, seasoned with salt, pepper, garlic and onion powder, cumin, chipotle chili powder, and oregano. Heat oil in a dutch oven and sear the chicken for about 5 minutes per side until they look like this. Remove the chicken, then add in the corn and let it char undisturbed before removing and setting to the side. Add in diced onions, bell peppers, and jalapenos. Saute until soft, then add in garlic and onion powder, cumin, chipotle chili powder, and oregano. Let toast for 30 seconds, then add in minced garlic and saute until fragrant. Then throw in tomato paste and cooker to this brick red, then pour in chicken stock. Add corn tortillas to hot chicken broth to soften, then pour in a blender along with chipotle and adobo peppers and blend it to smooth. Pour this mixture in a pot along with petite diced tomatoes and tomato sauce. Add the chicken to the pot, bring to a boil, then let simmer for 25 minutes. Next, blend cream cheese along with some of the broth then add it to the pot, then stir and marinate jack cheese a handful at a time until melted. Throw in the corn and black beans then shred the chicken and add it back to the pot. Let simmer on low for a few minutes then squeeze in fresh lime juice and add in chopped cilantro. I topped the soup with jalapenos, avocados, and crispy tortilla strips. Check out the link in my bio for the full recipe. It may not be beef son, but it's definitely what's for dinner.
